parameters.command: set +e; echo "=== SAMBA4_AD_HEALTH_START ==="; echo "TIME=$(date -Is)"; echo "HOST=$(hostname -f 2>/dev/null || hostname)"; echo "=== SERVICE ==="; if pgrep -f "samba" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "SERVICE_STATUS=active"; else echo "SERVICE_STATUS=inactive"; fi; echo "=== CONFIG ==="; testparm -s 2>&1 | tail -n 100; echo "=== AD PORTS ==="; ss -lntup 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':(53|88|135|139|389|445|464|636|3268|3269)([[:space:]]|$)' || true; echo "=== DOMAIN ==="; samba-tool domain info localhost -s /etc/samba/smb.conf 2>&1; echo "=== DNS ==="; DOMAIN="${SAMBA_DOMAIN:-$(hostname -d 2>/dev/null)}"; if [ -n "$DOMAIN" ]; then host -t A "$DOMAIN" 2>&1 || true; host -t SRV "_ldap._tcp.$DOMAIN" 2>&1 || true; host -t SRV "_kerberos._udp.$DOMAIN" 2>&1 || true; fi; echo "=== KERBEROS ==="; klist 2>&1 || true; echo "=== REPLICATION ==="; samba-tool drs showrepl -s /etc/samba/smb.conf 2>&1; echo "=== FSMO ==="; samba-tool fsmo show -s /etc/samba/smb.conf 2>&1; echo "=== SYSVOL_NETLOGON ==="; test -d /var/lib/samba/sysvol && echo "SYSVOL_DIRECTORY=OK" || echo "SYSVOL_DIRECTORY=MISSING"; smbclient -L localhost -N 2>&1 | grep -Ei 'SYSVOL|NETLOGON' || true; echo "=== DATABASE ==="; samba-tool dbcheck --cross-ncs       -s /etc/samba/smb.conf 2>&1 | tail -n 200; echo "=== DISK ==="; df -P -h / /var/lib/samba /var/log 2>&1 || true; echo "=== MEMORY ==="; free -h 2>&1 || true; echo "=== TIME ==="; timedatectl status 2>&1 | head -n 30 || true; chronyc tracking 2>&1 || true; echo "=== RECENT_ERRORS ==="; journalctl --since "1 hour ago" --no-pager 2>&1 | grep -Ei 'samba|smbd|winbind|error|failed|critical|panic|denied|timeout' | tail -n 200 || true; echo "=== SAMBA4_AD_HEALTH_END ==="
